newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Westmont Land eyeing Kenyan hotels - report.
newsitem.headline: Westmont Land eyeing Kenyan hotels - report.

text.p: Malaysia's Westmont Land (Asia) Bhd is seeking to acquire three hotels in Kenya and plans to build another power barge in the country, a local newspaper said on Thursday.
Westmont Land has submitted a bid for the Grand Regency Hotel, a five-star hotel in Nairobi, the Star quoted Westmont group managing director Joseph Chong as saying.
The company was also seeking to buy a hotel in Mombasa and another in the Masai Mara game reserve to establish a hotel chain in the country, he said.

Chong said Westmont Land was also looking at an additional 96-megawatt power barge to be built and stationed adjacent to its first power barge in Mombasa. The 48-megawatt barge, costing $50 million, is scheduled to begin operation in April.
"We must go through the process of tender but we are confident that with our track record and quick delivery of the first barge, we can beat any other international bid," he told the Star.
Chong said Westmont Land intends to make east Africa its stronghold in overseas investments and plans to invest heavily in the region.
Westmont Land officials could not be immediately reached for comment.
